headline: EKATI ENTERS RECEIVERSHIP — No Bids From 140 Parties; NWT Diamond Mine Closes 3 Years Early, Ottawa Loses $185M
snippet: A BC Supreme Court appointed PricewaterhouseCoopers as receiver for Arctic Canadian Diamond Company on July 14 after Ekati's sale process attracted no bids despite 140 'potentially interested parties' being contacted ahead of the July 10 deadline. Ottawa had committed approximately $185 million in loans to the mine — including a final $50 million tranche never disbursed — and the NWT government called the outcome 'a difficult day.' The mine had been planned to operate until 2029; it will now take about five weeks to wind down operations before reclamation begins, ending over two decades of diamond production from Canada's Northwest Territories.

headline: CHILE SUPPLY SQUEEZE PUSHES COPPER TO 4-WEEK HIGH — Cochilco Cuts 2026 to 5.75Mt; $6.30/lb on Grade, Water Woes
snippet: Copper futures climbed above $6.30 per pound on July 15 — a four-week high — as Chile's 2026 production outlook deteriorated across multiple fronts: Cochilco cut its national estimate to 5.75 million tonnes (from a projected 3.7% growth to a 2% decline), El Teniente remains capped near 301,000 tonnes per year after a 2025 accident, the 14-year Atacama drought has reservoirs at 30% capacity, and the structural transition from oxide to sulfide mining continues to suppress grades. Softer US inflation data provided an additional tailwind by compressing Fed rate-hike odds — but Chile's compounding supply crunch is the primary driver and analysts caution it could persist through H2 2026.

headline: ABRASILVER: 109m OF 221 g/t SILVER AT OCULTO WEST — 14m Peaks 580 g/t; Extends Pit Shell Downward (TSX:ABRA)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / AbraSilver Resource Corp.
snippet: AbraSilver Resource Corp. (TSX: ABRA) reported Phase VI drill hole DDH 26-036 at the previously undrilled Oculto West zone of its Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina, returning 109 metres at 221 g/t silver and 0.72 g/t gold — including 14 metres at 580 g/t silver — the single best intercept of the current program. Diablillos is already one of Argentina's largest undeveloped silver-gold projects; these results confirm mineralization extends below the conceptual open-pit model and establish a meaningful depth vector that could materially grow the existing inferred resource in a previously untested direction.

headline: ZODIAC GOLD'S ARTHINGTON FIRES UP 5,000m PROGRAM — 37/39 Historical Holes Hit, Up to 55.9 g/t Au (TSXV:ZAU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Zodiac Gold Inc.
snippet: Zodiac Gold Inc. (TSXV: ZAU) launched a new 3,000–5,000 metre diamond drill program at its Arthington discovery within the Todi Gold Project in Liberia, building on a track record of gold hits in 37 of 39 historical holes with intercepts reaching 55.9 g/t gold. The 2026 program targets depth and strike extensions along the 16-kilometre Monterra Trend and tightens drill density to support a maiden mineral resource estimate; a second rig is being considered for Q4 2026 to accelerate results. Concurrent drilling continues at the Ben Ben to Youth Camp targets along strike within the same land package.

headline: SWAYZE CENTRAL'S FIRST DRILL IN 16 YEARS — Canadian Goldfields 1,500m Program Starts July 21; Prior Hit 4.05 g/t Over 35m (TSXV:CGM)
snippet: Canadian Goldfields Discovery Corp. (TSXV: CGM) signed a drilling contract with Gateway Drilling Ltd. for an inaugural 1,500-metre diamond drill program at its Swayze Central Gold Project in Ontario's Swayze Greenstone Belt, with drilling expected to commence July 21, 2026 — the first program at the project in 16 years. Historical 2010 results include 35.0 metres at 4.05 g/t gold (including 15.4 metres at 7.76 g/t) and 40.0 metres at 2.65 g/t gold. The 2026 program supplements an ongoing 6,000-sample soil geochemical survey and will test both historical targets and newly identified zones from geological data review.

headline: KUTCHO COPPER'S FIRST MULTI-TARGET VMS DRILL IN 15 YEARS — 11 Holes at BC Copper-Zinc Could Double Resource (TSXV:KC)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kutcho Copper Corp.
snippet: Kutcho Copper Corp. (TSXV: KC) commenced the first comprehensive multi-target exploration drill program at its NW British Columbia copper-zinc project in over 15 years, deploying two diamond drill rigs across 11 holes at three VMS satellite targets: Hamburger (3 holes), Gap (2 holes), and Esso West (6 holes). Each hole is paired with down-hole EM surveys to vector follow-up drilling. The strategic goal is to potentially double the existing VMS resource base and extend mine life in support of a formal construction decision at this already feasibility-stage, high-grade copper-zinc development project.

headline: TREKOR Q2 COPPER: 36 MILLION POUNDS — Gibraltar BC 30.3M lbs; Florence AZ ISR 5.2M lbs; Annual Guidance Held (TSX:TKO)
snippet: Trekor Metals Ltd. (TSX: TKO) produced 36 million pounds of copper in Q2 2026 from two complementary operations: Gibraltar in British Columbia delivered 30.3 million pounds of copper and 559,000 pounds of molybdenum from the Connector Pit at life-of-mine average grades, while Florence Copper in Arizona produced 5.2 million pounds of copper cathode via in-situ recovery from 110 production wells at approximately 3,400 gallons per minute. Full-year 2026 guidance remains unchanged at 110–115 million pounds for Gibraltar and 30–35 million pounds for Florence Copper.

headline: MASIVO CONFIRMS 3.25% CuEq AT BOSTON MINE — 45 ft at 1.73 g/t Au + 34.7 g/t Ag; Peak 6.39% in Nevada (TSXV:MASS)
source_name: Investing News Network / Masivo Silver Corp.
snippet: Masivo Silver Corp. (TSXV: MASS) confirmed high-grade gold-copper mineralization directly beneath the historic Boston Mine in northeastern Nevada, with hole BM26-01 returning 45 feet at 1.73 g/t gold, 34.7 g/t silver, and 1.14% copper (3.25% copper equivalent), including a 5-foot high-grade core at 2.86 g/t gold, 84.7 g/t silver, and 2.67% copper (6.39% CuEq). The intercept lies beneath historic stope workings, establishing that high-grade polymetallic mineralization persists and expands at depth beyond the historic footprint in a Nevada district with existing infrastructure and limited modern exploration.

headline: SILVER $58.45 — US Airstrikes Reignite Oil Spike, Fed Stays Hawkish; Two Soft CPI/PPI Prints Can't Crack $60 Resistance
snippet: Silver traded at $58.45 on July 15 — unable to sustain a break above $60 per ounce despite back-to-back softer US inflation prints (June CPI 3.5%, PPI -0.3%). The drag: renewed US airstrikes on Iran and reinstatement of a naval blockade near the Strait of Hormuz pushed oil up 9% over five trading days, reigniting inflation expectations and keeping the Federal Reserve firmly hawkish. The dynamic reveals the structural ceiling on the current silver rally — energy-shock geopolitics immediately reset rate expectations upward even when underlying inflation data eases. Silver remains 52% below its January 2026 all-time high of $121.62 per ounce.

headline: GOLDSILVER.COM: GOLD'S CASE INTACT AFTER 27% DECLINE — H2 2026 Analysis; Fed Pivot and Macro Risks Are Key Catalysts
snippet: GoldSilver.com's July 2026 outlook argues that despite gold trading approximately 27% below its January all-time high near $5,589 — now around $4,061 — the structural investment case is fully intact. The base case for H2 is consolidation (±5% around $4,100), not collapse; the upside scenario returns gold to $4,500 on a Fed pivot or deteriorating macro conditions, while a hard risk event could target $5,000. Three catalysts are identified for a restart: a clear dovish Fed signal, worsening economic conditions increasing safe-haven demand, or institutional investor re-entry — all against a backdrop of central banks buying an average 1,000 tonnes per year since 2022 and sovereign debt at historic highs globally.
